title: Special Order for Louisiana Public Service Commission, ex parte. — This Special Order ratifies votes taken by Commissioner Francis acting as the Commission’s representative on the Regional State Committee of the Southwest Power Pool.

documents.text:
LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                            SPECIAL ORDER NUMBER 66-2026

                      LOUISIANA PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION
                                   EX PARTE

In re: This Special Order ratifies votes taken by Commissioner Francis acting as the
Commission’s representative on the Regional State Committee of the Southwest Power Pool.

             (Decided at the September 16, 2026 Business and Executive Session.)


                                            ORDER

I.     OVERVIEW

       This matter was on the Business and Executive Session (“B&E”) Agenda for ratification
of votes taken on August 3, 2026 by Commissioner Francis as the Louisiana Public Service
Commission (“LPSC” or “Commission”) representative on the Regional State Committee of the
Southwest Power Pool. Staff followed the protocols set forth in Special Order 17-2019 to consult
with the Executive Secretary and the Chairman and to make a recommendation to Commissioner
Francis prior to the vote. The protocols also require that the vote be ratified at a following B&E.
The votes being ratified are summarized as follows:

           1. The first voting item approved RR784 setting the planning reserve
              margin requirements for load serving entities at 17% in the summer
              and 38% in the winter in SPP governing documents. Commissioner
              Francis voted in favor of this item.

           2. The second voting item assigned the Eastern Interconnection Area
              of the Loveland Area Project Zone to the North Deliverability Area.
              Commissioner Francis voted in favor of this item.

           3. The third voting item assigned the Eastern Interconnection Area for
              the Loveland Area Project Zone to the Nebraska Subregion.
              Commissioner Francis abstained from voting on this item.

           4. The fourth voting item proposed to limit the footprint of the North
              Subregion to only the area in the Eastern Interconnection and to
              calculate transmission rates applied in the North Subregion by
              combining the loads and applicable revenue requirements in the
              North Subregion with the loads and applicable revenue requirements
              in the Montana Subregion. Commissioner Francis voted in favor of
              this item.

           5. The fifth voting item proposed clarifications for establishing the
              Consolidated Planning Process for the Western Interconnection,
              including establishing a GRID-C that is separate from the Eastern
              Interconnection, defining the Western Interconnection cost
              allocation Subregions, including adjustments of the SPP East
              Region cost allocation Subregions and Deliverability Areas, and
              establishing a proper distribution of GRID-C revenue for the
              Western Interconnection. Commissioner Francis voted in favor of
              this item.

II.    COMMISSION JURISDICTION AND AUTHORITY

       The jurisdiction of the Commission is set forth by the Louisiana Constitution Article IV,
Section 21, which provides:


                                                                       Special Order No. 66-2026
                                                                                          Page 1
               The commission shall regulate all common carriers and public
              utilities and have such other regulatory authority as provided by law.
              It shall adopt and enforce reasonable rules, regulations, and
              procedures necessary for the discharge of its duties, and shall have
              other powers and perform other duties as provided by law.


III.   CONCLUSION

         This matter was placed on the Commission’s September 16, 2026 B&E Agenda for
ratification by the full Commission. On motion of Chairman Skrmetta, seconded by Commissioner
Lewis, with Vice Chairman Coussan and Commissioner Campbell concurring, and Commissioner
Francis abstaining, the Commission voted to ratify the votes taken by Commissioner Francis on
August 3, 206 as the Louisiana Public Service Commission representative to the SPP RSC.

This Order is effective immediately.




BY ORDER OF THE COMMISSION
BATON ROUGE, LOUISIANA
October 7, 2026
